## state, county

```{r}
state_percent_2020 <- read_csv("state_percent_2020.csv")

state_percent_2020 <- state_percent_2020 %>%
  mutate(
    percent_2020 = readr::parse_number(oct)
  )

view(state_percent_2020)

where <- data_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / nrow(data_full)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    state_percent_2020,
    by = "state"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    delta = (percent - percent_2020)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

View(where)

where_appendix <- where %>%
  select(state, n, percent, percent_2020, delta) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(percent, 2),
    percent_2020 = round(percent_2020, 2),
    delta = round(delta, 2)
)
    

View(where_appendix)   

state_table <- where_appendix %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    caption = "Geographic Distribution of Survey Respondents Compared with the 2020 U.S. Population",
    label = "tab:state_distribution",
    col.names = c(
      "State",
      "N",
      "Sample (\\%)",
      "2020 U.S. Population (\\%)",
      "$\\Delta$ (p.p.)"
    ),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
    font_size = 9
  )

state_table

writeLines(
  as.character(state_table),
  "state_distribution_table.tex"
)
```

Map?

```{r}
state_map_data <- where %>%
  select(state, percent)

sample_map<-plot_usmap(data = state_map_data, values = "percent", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_continuous(
    name = "Sample (%)",
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01, suffix = "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Distribution of Respondents",
    subtitle = "Share of the full sample residing in each state"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
sample_map

```

```{r}
ggsave("sample_state_map.pdf", sample_map, width = 9, height = 6)
```




```{r}

delta_map_data <- where %>%
  select(state, delta)

delta_map <- plot_usmap(data = delta_map_data, values = "delta", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = expression(Delta ~ "(p.p.)"),
    low = "steelblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State-Level Over- and Underrepresentation in the Sample",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate a larger sample share than the state's 2020 share of the U.S. population"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
delta_map
```

```{r}
ggsave("delta_map.pdf", delta_map, width = 9, height = 6)
```
